encoding: Pinned Intel unformatted stream with `-convert big_endian`; default REAL and INTEGER are each 4 bytes under `-real-size 32 -i4`
arm_is_bound_by: distinct fresh OLD and FIX current working directories; state filenames are not shared across arms
preflight: reject any pre-existing state_*.bin, state_calls_*.txt, or kdm6_trace_rank*.bits in either case directory
block_header: stage_id, rank, call_id, timestep: big-endian int32
ilo, ihi, jlo, jhi, klo, khi: big-endian int32

post_process.capture: after first internal-loop process state update

kdm62d_return.capture: private KDM62D output before public host-field copyback

wrapper_return.capture: public KDM6 exit fields after number conversion

selected_entry.block_record_count: number of selected corners in tile times (kte-kts+1)

selected_return.block_record_count: number of selected corners in tile times (kte-kts+1)

coverage.expected_scope: union of actual KDM6 runtime core-tile bounds clipped to history interior
coverage.ownership: rank and local call ID plus actual tile bounds recorded in block header; reject duplicate owners and OLD/FIX mask mismatch

invocation_manifest.expected_private_mask: for every actual step-1 KDM6 call and each j in jts..jte: i=its..ite, k=kts..kte
invocation_manifest.expected_global_mask: union of actual call tile bounds clipped to history interior

field_units_and_representation.T_K_DERIVED_TH_TIMES_PII: actual temperature, K, stored separately from TH
field_units_and_representation.QV_PUBLIC_RAW_QC_PUBLIC_RAW_QR_PUBLIC_RA: KDM6 public mass-mixing-ratio values (kg kg-1 convention); host denominator convention not independently bound
field_units_and_representation.NN_PUBLIC_RAW_NC_PUBLIC_RAW_NI_PUBLIC_RA: raw public host number-field values; no number unit assigned; KDM6 source multiplies them by DEN on entry
field_units_and_representation.BG_PUBLIC_RAW_BG_INTERNAL: raw graupel diagnostic state; no unit assigned
field_units_and_representation.DEN_ARGUMENT_RAW: exact DEN argument values; density unit basis and dry/moist basis unclaimed
field_units_and_representation.QV_INTERNAL_RAW_QC_INTERNAL_QI_INTERNAL_: same KDM6 mixing-ratio representation as public Q fields
field_units_and_representation.NC_INTERNAL_NI_INTERNAL_NN_INTERNAL_NR_I: raw KDM6 nci/nrs values; public number fields multiplied by DEN on entry; physical density basis unclaimed

unit_limits: TH_PUBLIC_RAW and T_K_DERIVED_TH_TIMES_PII are distinct fields
public number fields are retained as raw values; no unit label is inferred
DEN_ARGUMENT_RAW is the exact DEN argument; AL/ALB/ALT are not captured or inferred
private NCI/NRS arrays are retained in their actual KDM6 internal representation
do not compare values across public/private fields without an explicit, source-backed conversion
